_comment: Texture theme registry. Loaded at runtime by engine::render::textures, so adding
or editing a theme needs no rebuild — drop BMPs in native/assets/textures/, edit
2 = lower wall       3 = upper wall   (split at WALL_SPLIT_V above the brush floor_y)
4 = legacy tunnel flat-colour — NEVER emitted by the classifier; leave undefined
5 = stair riser / door+hole frame sides and lintel
6 = doorframe floor  7 = structural brace (simple_blue reuses it for railings)
An absent zone key means undefined: the classifier still tags triangles for it but
the renderer skips them, so geometry lands in that zone invisibly. Define 0-3 at
minimum. `repeat` is a UV scale applied in the shader, not baked into the mesh, so
changing it is a bind-group swap with no re-bake.
Levels persist a theme by NAME, so themes may be added, removed or reordered
without retexturing saved levels, and order is otherwise just the UI listing order.
ONE exception: level format v3 and earlier stored a bare scheme INDEX, and those
files migrate by reading it as a position in this list — so the first ten entries
below must keep their current order for pre-v4 levels to load correctly.
`facility_white_tile` and `simple_blue` are required by name (see textures.rs).
